_doc: Which engine runs each role (claude | codex) and which models. `zulu setup --step engines` writes `engine`; scripts/engine.mjs reads it (resident falls back to worker; default claude). Claude models: master/worker/workerFallback. Codex: codex.model (Mission Control) / codex.workerModel (workers, residents, triage) — empty = Codex's own default from ~/.codex/config.toml.

contextWindows._doc: Claude context windows by model-id prefix (src/context.mjs). '[1m]' in a model string forces 1M. See https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/models
